title: Definition of Electric Field
text: Electric field E = F/q, which means F = qE. The field represents the force that would act on each coulomb of charge.

title: Direction of Force
text: Positive charges feel force in the same direction as E (toward negative plate). Negative charges feel force opposite to E (toward positive plate).

title: Uniform Field
text: Between parallel plates, the field is uniform - it has the same strength and direction everywhere. The force on the charge will be constant.
